Contract ProcessSaleService::makeNewSale(): Boolean {
	precondition:
		cashDesk.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		cashDesk.IsOpened = true and
		(self.CurrentSale.oclIsUndefined() = true or
		self.CurrentSale.IsComplete = true)
	postcondition:
		let newSale: Sale in
		newSale.oclIsNew() and
		cashDesk.ContainedSales->includes(newSale) and
		newSale.BelongedCashDesk = cashDesk and
		newSale.IsComplete = false and
		newSale.IsReadytoPay = false and
		self.CurrentSale = newSale and
		result = true
}
